baseline: same clean multimodal encoders and shared representation; no persistent state, CASM, verifier, outcome update, or state write; query receives the explicitly addressed entity representation directly plus i/j/operator indices.
decision_rule: Report both models without model selection. Persistence is supported only if PLM exceeds the feed-forward mean by >=0.05 and the composition-bootstrap 95% intervals do not overlap; otherwise report no persistence advantage on this task.
leakage_gates: no target outcome supplied before prediction
interpretation_boundary: This isolates persistence only on the clean synthetic E2E-008 task. It does not test learned addressing, operator discovery, semantic multimodal understanding, or long-horizon memory.
